yaml:
name: Release

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  call-run-nra:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/run_nra.yml
    with:
      branch: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
      nova_repo: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name || github.repository }}
